title: The Man Who Burned in the Sun
synopsis: N'Gavu partied with his village, drank in the sun, and woke to skin that blisters in daylight — porphyria cutanea tarda, not a sunburn he can shrug off.

chapters.heading: Village party
chapters.body: N'Gavu was out with friends from the village — beer all night, yellow jacket, nothing felt wrong. He drank like he always does after work.
chapters.visualHint: N'Gavu in mustard-yellow party jacket with brown beer bottle, night party or pool hall — same face, NOT hospital gown

chapters.heading: Disruption
chapters.body: The next afternoon, walking home in the sun, his hands and face began to peel and blister. By evening he could not stand light on his forearms.
chapters.visualHint: Same N'Gavu squinting in afternoon sun, yellow jacket, blistering forearms starting — outdoor village path

chapters.heading: Embodiment
chapters.body: In the ED he winces when the triage window lights his arms. He took off the yellow shirt for the gown — it hangs on the chair. His beer bottles are on the side table; he says they are his property.
chapters.visualHint: N'Gavu supine in hospital gown on stretcher, mustard-yellow shirt on bedside chair, two beer bottles on overbed table, shields blistered forearms from window light

chapters.heading: Escalation
chapters.body: Fragile bullae on sun-exposed skin, milia on the hands, darker patches and coarse hair on the dorsal hands — the pattern whispers porphyrin, not a simple sunburn.
chapters.visualHint: Close on N'Gavu's blistered dorsal hands and forearms, same face visible, ED bay, monitor upper-right

chapters.heading: Crisis point
chapters.body: If porphyrins keep building while orders wait, every photon through the glass keeps injuring skin — and alcohol may still be driving the trigger until you prove otherwise.
chapters.visualHint: N'Gavu tense on stretcher, eyes toward bright window, beer bottles still on side table, clinical stress

chapters.heading: Recontextualization
chapters.body: The peeling was never just sun — porphyrins in skin, alcohol as trigger, light as the weapon. Name it and the pathway opens.
chapters.visualHint: N'Gavu calmer in dimmed bay, yellow shirt still on chair, forearms settling, relief mixed with shame — wide bedside depth
